title: evoproto v0.1.0: reference implementation of an evidence-gated, evolution-informed engineering design framework
description:
Reference implementation accompanying the article From Evolutionary Biology Data to Technological Prototypes: An AI-Driven Engineering Design Framework with an Evidence-Gated Validation Protocol.

The package implements the evolutionary–engineering knowledge graph (six node types, nine typed edge types, provenance on every edge), phylogenetic signal and convergence measures (Blomberg's K, Pagel's lambda, Stayton's C1 with a Brownian-motion simulation p-value), analog retrieval with a transfer-uncertainty measure, constrained multi-objective search with Deb's constraint domination and an exact two-objective hypervolume, the evidence gate with its abstention branch, and the three-arm pre-registered experimental protocol with phylogenetic block splitting, ablation and paired non-parametric statistics. It also regenerates every figure of the paper and reruns the synthetic dry run in a few seconds.

No biological records are bundled. The package runs in SYNTHETIC mode and its source connectors (Open Tree of Life, MorphoBank, Paleobiology Database) do not access the network unless the caller opts in, so the whole pipeline can be executed and audited offline while the licensed corpus is assembled.
